name: Cherry G83 (RS 6000)
notes: 64-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 0) of a real Cherry G83, rebuilt from an lsusb or TMK descriptor listing of the device, at the length the listing states: https://gist.github.com/61232069866950aee280623f4901ff84/7bac7622c8b585ddaa9d12d0d2e628169fbdf705#file-gistfile1-txt. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
